q: Chelsea put two small boys behind the goal of their giant keeper William Fatty Foulke. Why?
a: To make him look even bigger
sub: The boys fetched the ball when it went out of play, and so ball boys were born.
note: Wikipedia William Foulke (footballer): Chelsea put two small boys behind his goal to draw attention to his size, which led to ball boys. Hedged weight sub replaced.
